assessment.why: Justin uniquely admits placing the blue bottle where it was recovered and also touching donor glass. Identification pending leaves his photography-of-replica account credible; other handlers have comparably direct opportunities.

plausibility_notes: Could be a source-to-glass chain, but several people touch bottles, favors and glasses. Distinguishing original from replica and rental from star glass is decisive; no justified exclusion on admissions alone.
